Name: Skell's Greenhouse
Author: skellady
Description:
[size=3]Retextures the inside of the greenhouse to fit more crops and 72 trees!

This mod was heavily inspired by DaisyNiko's wonderful [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3969]Oasis Greenhouse[/url]!
[/size]
[size=5]Installation:[/size]

[size=3]1. Install the latest version of [/size][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][size=3]
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[size=3]3. Install the mod (manual download is recommended over vortex/mod managers)[/size]
[size=3]4. Unzip the file, place the folder in your Mods folder[/size]
[size=3]5. Launch your game and enjoy! [/size]

[size=5]Compatibility:[/size]
[size=3]It should work with any custom farm you may be using. If you encounter any issues, submit a report in the Posts tab with a [/size][url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url].
If your custom farm comes with a changed greenhouse interior (such as IFR2), look for an option to disable it inside the config.json.﻿
